metadata.description: ENCA self-hosted (R06): Azure Container Apps running the published image with scale-to-zero, so an instance used by one team costs close to nothing while idle. After deployment, add the app's HTTPS URL (in the deployment outputs) as a SPA redirect URI on your Entra app registration - sign-in fails with AADSTS50011 until you do. See SELF-HOSTING.md.
Name for the container app; also prefixes the environment and log workspace.
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group's region.

Container image. This is the beta-channel copy of the template, so it defaults to :beta - use ghcr.io/nurejev/enca:latest for production, or your own fork's image. Anonymous pull requires the GHCR package to be Public.

OPTIONAL but recommended: the Application (client) ID of YOUR OWN Entra app registration, from New-EncaAppRegistration.ps1. Leave blank to use the shared multi-tenant registration. Setting it is what makes this instance yours - own registration, own consent record, own audit trail.
OPTIONAL: your Directory (tenant) ID, for a SINGLE-TENANT registration (New-EncaAppRegistration.ps1 -SingleTenant). Leave blank for a multi-tenant one. Ignored unless clientId is also set.

nextStep.value: [format('Add https://{0} as a SPA redirect URI on your Entra app registration (Authentication -> Single-page application), or sign-in fails with AADSTS50011. New-EncaAppRegistration.ps1 in the repo does this for you.', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.App/containerApps', parameters('appName')), '2024-03-01').configuration.ingress.fqdn)]
